```plato
    // Component-wise remainder against a real factor.
    Modulo(z: Complex, scalar: Number): Complex
        => (z.Real.Modulo(scalar), z.Imaginary.Modulo(scalar));
```

```plato

    // The remainder against a constant factor. The derivative is unchanged:
    // away from the wrap points the remainder differs from the value by a
    // locally constant multiple of the divisor.
    Modulo(x: DualNumber, scalar: Number): DualNumber
        => (x.Value.Modulo(scalar), x.Derivative);
```
